snippet.title: Pokémon Luminous Land - Fangame Release!
snippet.description:
https://tinyurl com/37y4sehe
(YouTube won't let new channels put links, so you'll have to type the period in between "tinyurl" and "com.")

Download the game at the Google Drive link above!

The Fabio Region is waiting for you, with 112 new Pokémon, a brand new region to explore, and new friends by your side!

Be sure to download the .txt files along with the game! They are guides and helpful logs, listing things like the full Pokédex, HM locations, and a full postgame content guide!

The full soundtrack, as well as all new Pokémon and Trainer sprites are also included in the folder as optional downloads!

Bug reports? Email them to luminousfangame@gmail.com please!



Pokemon, Fangame, Pokemon Fangame, Fakemon
